entities.name: Online Bookstore System
entities.description: An AWS-hosted online bookstore built for 1M MAU, delivering catalog browsing, secure checkout, reviews, and personalized recommendations.

entities.name: Customers
entities.description: Primary system users interacting via web and mobile interfaces to browse catalogs, purchase books, and write reviews.

entities.name: Authors/Publishers
entities.description: Users who interact with the system regarding catalog content and publications.

entities.name: Store Administrators
entities.description: Users responsible for managing the e-commerce platform, catalogs, orders, and support.

entities.name: Payment Gateway
entities.description: External system processing secure financial transactions via client-side tokenization and webhook callbacks.

entities.name: Third-Party Shipping APIs
entities.description: External APIs used for fulfillment and shipping synchronization.

entities.name: Notification Service
entities.description: External notification service (SES/SendGrid) for sending system emails and alerts.

entities.name: Customer Support CRM
entities.description: External CRM system for managing customer support operations.

entities.name: Identity Provider
entities.description: External Identity Provider (AWS Cognito/Auth0) handling authentication and MFA.

entities.name: AWS CloudFront CDN/WAF
entities.description: Edge and security infrastructure for DDoS protection, TLS 1.3 termination, and content delivery.

entities.name: Route 53
entities.description: DNS routing service for global traffic management.

entities.name: AWS KMS
entities.description: Service for encryption at rest using AES-256.

interfaces.description: Connect via HTTPS (TLS 1.3) through CDN/WAF for browsing, purchasing, and reviews
Interact with system via web and mobile interfaces
Administer the store and manage operations
Integrates for secure payment processing and webhook callbacks
Integrates for order fulfillment and shipping
Authenticates users via OIDC/OAuth 2.0 supporting MFA

naming_conventions: External systems are named using clear, descriptive product or functional names
Users and actors are designated by their specific roles in plural form
